about: Recorded background sounds for the Voice Changer: the platform’s own ambience loops (made with AI sound models, or synthesized), one per place, the newest version of each. Names are plain descriptions; no town or shop names.

beds.name: Rain dripping from a shelter
beds.about: Steady gentle rain pattering on a porch roof and dripping from the eaves.

beds.name: A river spillway
beds.about: A broad soft rush of shallow water over worn stone, outdoors.

beds.name: A park fountain up close
beds.about: Water falling over stone into a basin, bright and splashy.

beds.name: Pipes dripping in a brick alley
beds.about: Slow drips onto stone and into a puddle, with a close brick echo.

beds.name: Water at a river dock
beds.about: Water lapping wooden pilings, reeds on the far bank, a loose rope tapping a post.

beds.name: Gentle water under a dock
beds.about: Quiet river water lapping beneath a wooden dock, a rope tapping now and then.

beds.name: A woodland creek
beds.about: A shallow creek trickling over stones, with a few birds.

beds.name: A harbor with boats creaking
beds.about: Water on pilings and boats creaking at their moorings.

beds.name: A small campfire
beds.about: A calm wood fire, soft crackles and small pops.

beds.name: Woods by day
beds.about: Leaves rustling overhead and small birds at different distances.

beds.name: Woods at night
beds.about: Crickets and leaves in a light breeze, with an owl now and then.

beds.name: A riverbank with birds
beds.about: A river running past a grassy bank, wind in big trees, water birds calling.

beds.name: A tractor far across the fields
beds.about: One distant engine droning over open country.

beds.name: Pigeons in a brick square
beds.about: Pigeons cooing and fluttering on ledges, a breeze, distant town traffic.

beds.name: Lawn sprinklers on a quiet street
beds.about: Lawn sprinklers ticking round over an empty street, an air conditioner far off.

beds.name: A lantern hissing under an arch
beds.about: A gas lantern hissing under a stone arch, pigeons on the stonework, a draught.

beds.name: An old iron gate in a draught
beds.about: A heavy iron gate creaking on its hinges in a slow draught, outdoors.

beds.name: Lanterns at night, almost silent
beds.about: An oil lantern guttering close by and a thin cold draught in bare branches.

beds.name: Neighbors talking on porches
beds.about: Many neighbors talking on porches, too far off to make out, and cicadas.

beds.name: A busy old video arcade
beds.about: Game machines chirping and chiming on both sides, bells and an electric hum.

beds.name: A metal workshop down the street
beds.about: An angle grinder cutting steel behind a roller door, a compressor cycling.

beds.name: A street food window at night
beds.about: A griddle sizzling through a sliding window, a cooler humming, alley echo.

beds.name: Bass through a brick wall at night
beds.about: Club music thumping through brick walls, a neon sign buzzing, a quiet street.

beds.name: A boat engine idling at a dock
beds.about: A low steady engine idling, heard from the dock.

beds.name: An old barbershop
beds.about: Electric clippers buzzing on and off, an oscillating fan, a chair creaking.

beds.name: A small busy bar
beds.about: Crowd chatter you cannot make out, glasses and bottles, a jukebox faint in the corner.

beds.name: A diner griddle
beds.about: A flat-top griddle hissing, cups and cutlery on ceramic, a faint murmur.

beds.name: A highway truck stop diner
beds.about: A fryer hissing, a small radio half lost in static, trucks passing outside.

beds.name: A small cafe
beds.about: Plates and cutlery clinking, cups on saucers and low chatter.

beds.name: A small corner store
beds.about: Cooler compressors humming, glass bottles clinking in crates, a register now and then.

beds.name: A quiet apartment
beds.about: A refrigerator humming in the next room, a clock ticking softly, a muffled street.

beds.name: Washers and dryers in a laundromat
beds.about: Washing machines churning and dryers tumbling, with a fluorescent hum.

beds.name: A hospital waiting room
beds.about: Slow soft monitor beeps and a ventilation hum in a quiet room.

beds.name: An old bowling alley
beds.about: Balls rolling down wooden lanes, pins crashing, the ball return rumbling.

beds.name: A bakery kitchen
beds.about: Metal trays and pans handled on a counter over a ventilation hum.

beds.name: An old indoor pool
beds.about: Water sloshing at the edge of a pool under a tiled roof.

beds.name: A film projector running
beds.about: A projector motor whirring and the film clicking steadily through it.

beds.name: A quiet art studio
beds.about: A quiet room with a clock, brush strokes, a jar set down, a street far off.

beds.name: A river heard through wooden walls
beds.about: River water outside a wooden boathouse, muffled by the walls.

beds.name: A quiet room with a fan hum
beds.about: A big quiet room with a low steady ventilation hum.
